The red wash and falling ash shipped earlier as v37.11. The pictures and critic score are still missing, because there is no camera stage that sets the clock to 45 or 5 seconds.

I only re-checked the code and the `DESIGN.md` section; nothing needed changing. The code is `burnFx()` in `dark_raiders.html`, drawn once per raid frame after the lighting and before the HUD. It has the red wash from 0 at 1:00 to 0.16 at 0:00 and up to 70 ash flakes, with the `BURN` counters as briefed. It is off when the raid is over, a nuke is running, or there is more than a minute left. The ash count drops when the graphics quality ladder sheds detail. Ash positions use `Math.random`, so the seed 4242 fingerprint stays as it was.

Still open:
- **Pictures and critic score:** I may not add a screen to `ui-screens-js.json` myself. The request is already in `alarms.md` (line 599): a raid frame at 45 s and at 5 s, day and night, both windows, 1080p and 4K.
- **4K two-window frame cost:** not measured. Lane workers may not drive a browser, so it falls to job 120k. The gate check only bounds one burn pass under 2 ms.
- **Reduce motion:** job 137 has not shipped. When it does, it should turn the ash off and keep the glow; the `DESIGN.md` section says so.

TASK WAITING: coordinator needs a camera stage added to `tools/handoff/shots/ui-screens-js.json` (raid frame at `G.timeLeft` 45 and 5, day and night, both windows) so the pictures and critic score can be taken.
